name: wisdomtwin
description: A private business twin for one role on the org chart. Slack is live. Gmail and Google Drive are coming soon. Every answer carries a citation from that role's index.

interface.shortDescription: Role twins with citations. Slack is live.
interface.longDescription: WisdomTwin builds a private business twin for one role, such as CRO or VP of Sales. Connect Slack with read-only access, ingest business communications into that role, and ask questions that come back with a citation on every claim. Gmail and Google Drive are coming soon while Google verification is in progress. WisdomTwin does not train on user data.
defaultPrompt: Connect Slack for example-corp.com as CRO.
Ingest recent Slack messages about the pipeline.
What did the role record say about Acme, and cite it?

positive.description: Connect a business domain with a role title
positive.prompt: Connect Slack for example-corp.com with the role title CRO.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the organization, role, and open tenure, and return a Slack authorization URL.

positive.prompt: Connect Slack for example-corp.com as CRO again.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the same role id and keep a single open tenure.

positive.prompt: Ingest Slack messages about the pipeline for this role.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a job id and chunk count. Each stored chunk carries the current tenure.

positive.prompt: What is the Acme pipeline stage?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer from the role index and include at least one citation with a uri and a snippet.
List Slack, the role title, the business domain, and the ingested chunk count.

negative.prompt: Connect Slack for gmail.com as CRO.
What did the board decide about pricing before anything is ingested?

negative.description: Gmail while the connector is gated
negative.prompt: Ingest my Gmail about the budget.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not take payment. WisdomTwin Pro is USD 20 per month, billed by WisdomTwin Inc through WisdomTwin checkout, outside this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial package. Slack role twins with citations. Gmail and Google Drive are coming soon.
